title: Base and indirect buffers share text

environment.system_features: ACL GMP GNUTLS LIBSELINUX LIBXML2 MODULES NATIVE_COMP NOTIFY INOTIFY PDUMPER SECCOMP SQLITE3 THREADS TREE_SITTER ZLIB

mechanism: Indirect buffers are distinct buffer objects whose text changes affect the base buffer.
hypothesis: Editing the indirect buffer should change the base buffer text while preserving separate buffer identities.
minimal_fixture: One base buffer and one indirect buffer.
predicted_behavior: The base buffer text changes after insertion in the indirect buffer; buffer-local state such as point can still differ.
counterexample: A checker that says only one buffer object changed misses shared text ownership.
derived_gym_requirement: Observations must include buffer identity, base-buffer/text-owner identity, and visited file identity separately.
